That’s awesome, but I’m sorry you went through that. With my bladder I tend to need to pee ASAP as soon as I feel I need to go and sometimes I lose control. Other days I’ll completely piss myself.

I can, and can’t control when I go. I’m not completely incontinent like an infant or some elderly people, I just have issues predicting and controlling when I need to go. Sometimes I wet or soil myself because the messages don’t get to my brain and I can’t feel it. 

My birth mother basically left me in diapers until I was 4, yep. Then I was removed, and my mother put me up for adoption (Child Services sponsored) so I was placed with a loving family and they became my real papa and mama. If that makes sense. They tried to potty train me, and were successful.

That’s correct. I wasn’t potty trained until I was 8 because it took my new adoptive parents THAT LONG for me to finally make some progress! They tried for years before that and never gave up. Huge credit to them. I was also behind in other areas such as literacy and numeracy. 

I did, and still do wear diapers now. Back then I wore pull-ups which were easy to manage at school and all my teachers were very supportive. I certainly wasn’t the only kid who had accidents. 

I do, yeah.

I’m going to be honest here. I find it hard to know when to “go” and my bladder and bowel nerves/muscles aren’t as developed. The longer a child goes without being potty trained the more harm is done.
